standard_prerequisites.name: Finite closure stages cl_n(A)
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same unit, the definition preceding the proposition (source lines 450-463): cl_0(A) = A, cl_{n+1}(A) = union of members, trcl(A) = union over n < omega of cl_n(A)
standard_prerequisites.use: Both halves of the proof unfold these definitions directly.

core_obligations: Extensivity (proof line 470): A = cl_0(A) is a summand of the union defining trcl(A), so A subset trcl(A) 'evidently'.
Transitivity (lines 470-473): if x in b in trcl(A), then b appears at some stage cl_n(A); by definition of the successor stage x then lies in cl_{n+1}(A), hence in the union trcl(A).
proof_roadmap: Read A off the zeroth stage.
Chase a member one stage forward.
